title: REMOVE_DETAILS payload
description: Remove small details after confirmation of a candidate list (v0.2 C.6; spec §10.6 rule 5).

confirmedRemoveIds.description: Faces the operator confirmed for removal; empty = discovery PREVIEW (candidate list, no change) or a valid empty COMMIT (D-325).

maxAreaM2.description: Candidate threshold: faces with 3D area < maxAreaM2. Omitted -> the profile's minFaceAreaM2; a value below minFaceAreaM2 is refused INVALID_PAYLOAD by the kernel (D-326).

maxDisplacementM.description: Largest admissible distance of a removed-face vertex to the vertex it collapses into. Omitted -> the project's planarTolM (D-330, as D-284).

$comment: [P] Field names. Candidate list: optional `command-result.candidates` on a discovery PREVIEW (D-325). `maxAreaM2`, `maxDisplacementM` added by 3D-105 (D-326, D-330; approved D-331).
